title: /config: the docked modal, the Pipeline sections and their rows, saved at once
description:
Per the map tickets 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, layout C By Stage, as revised) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, /config models). Prototype: branch prototype/config at b4700d2, src/shell/draw/prototype_config.rs (cargo run -- __prototype-config).

/config (added to Ticket 4's command table) docks beside the live Shell in the right 58% in Ticket 5's frame (a box over the dimmed Shell under 110 columns), thick purple border titled /config, badges on the title: '✗ N checks' (Ticket 10), 'N waiting', 'run live', 'saved <time>'.

Left, PIPELINE: Plan+Impl, Review, Debate, Fix, Address, joined by │, each with a one-line summary (app and model); a divider; Apps (N of M installed), Skills (N installed) and TypeSafe (on/off), whose pages come in Tickets 10 and 21 (their summary line only until then). Right: the picked Stage: its title with its apps, a description, its rows grouped per row (app, model, effort). The rows: Plan+Impl (one app, one model, one effort; the same-model toggle comes in Ticket 10), Review, Review if limited, the Moderator (under Debate), Debate side A (also runs the ponytail audit), side B, Fix, Address.

Picking: a pick list replaces the right pane: type to filter, ↑↓, Enter picks, Esc back. Changing a row's app leads straight into that app's model list, and the pair saves together. Model lists come from each App: claude's aliases (default, fable, opus, sonnet, haiku), codex's from codex debug models --bundled filtered to visibility=list, read when /config opens; 'type an id…' at the foot; each model labelled with its family. Effort: the App's levels (codex supported_reasoning_levels, claude low to max), or '— <app> has no effort flag'. Every named pick is probed once on save with a one-line prompt (claude -p --model <id>, codex exec -m <id>) through Tools, off the screen thread; a probe in progress shows in the foot; on failure the old value stays and the App's error shows. App lists hold claude and codex (the greyed apps come with the Apps page).

Foot, two lines: the note on the row under the cursor, or the saved notice, a probe in progress, a confirmation, typed input. Keys: ↑↓ Stage, Enter or → opens it, ↑↓ setting, Enter changes, ← or Esc back, Esc closes.

Saving: every change saves at once to .harness/config.json (Ticket 7), no Save step. During a run, Stages that start afterwards use it, running ones keep theirs, and RECENT logs 'config: <row> <old> → <new>'.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Screen tests over fake Tools: /config opens docked at 160x45 and as a box at 100x30; Review → codex → a model from a fake codex debug models reply → an effort saves all three in config.json; a typed id whose probe fails keeps the old value and shows the error; a change during a fake run logs 'config: …' and the next Stage's argv carries it. TestBackend renders of the Pipeline list, a Stage page and a pick list.
